Enable force_ocr to OCR pages that already contain native text

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'application/pdf', uri: 'https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf'), { 'force_ocr' => true, 'ocr' => { 'backend' => 'tesseract', 'enabled' => true, 'language' => ['eng'] } })
puts result.results[0].content.inspect
```
